title: The Lost Sheep
subtitle: A story Jesus told about a shepherd who never stopped looking

scenes.title: A Story Jesus Told
beats: Jesus was always making friends with people that nobody else liked. Some people grumbled about it. “Why does He eat with people like that?”
So Jesus told them a story.

scenes.title: One Hundred Sheep
beats: “Once there was a shepherd who had one hundred sheep,” Jesus said. “He loved every single one of them.”
Every evening, the shepherd counted his sheep as they went into the pen. “Ninety-seven, ninety-eight, ninety-nine…” Wait! One little lamb was missing!

scenes.title: Looking Everywhere
beats: The shepherd left the ninety-nine sheep safe in the pen, and off he went to look for the one that was lost.
He looked over the hills and down in the valleys. He looked behind rocks and through prickly bushes. It was getting dark, but he kept on calling, “Little lamb! Where are you?”

scenes.title: Found!
beats: Then he heard it: a tiny little “Baa!” There was the lamb, stuck in a thorny bush, cold and scared.
The shepherd gently lifted the little lamb out and put it up on his shoulders. He wasn’t cross at all. He was so happy! And he carried it all the way home.

scenes.title: Rejoice With Me!
beats: When he got home, the shepherd called all his friends and neighbors. “Come and celebrate with me! I found my lost sheep!”
Then Jesus said, “That is how God feels. All of heaven has a party whenever one lost person comes home to God.”
You are like that little lamb. God loves you so much, He will always come looking for you.

questions: Why didn’t the shepherd just stay home with his ninety-nine other sheep?
How do you think the little lamb felt when the shepherd found it?
Jesus said God is like that shepherd. How does it feel to know God will always come looking for you?

verse.text: Rejoice with me, for I have found my lost sheep!
